Dear Webmail User,
We are upgrading all accounts to our new spam protection system. Your account has not been upgraded yet. To avoid service interruption, kindly upgrade by entering your email and password on the form below.
UPGRADE NOW: http://mailbox-quota-center.net/upgrade.php
Thank you for your cooperation.
Webmail Team

Congratulations! Based on your academic achievements you have been nominated for membership in our prestigious honor society. Secure your lifetime membership and certificate by paying the one-time induction fee of $95 today. Offer valid for 72 hours only.

You've received an invoice from Geek Squad Services
Amount due: $499.99
Due date: Upon receipt
If you did not authorize this payment, call our billing support team at +1 (808) 555-0144 to cancel the transaction and receive a full refund.

Great news! You may qualify for complete student loan forgiveness under the new federal program. Spots are limited. Call now or reply with your FSA ID username and password so our specialists can file your application today.

Your 2026 W-2 form is ready
All employees must review their W-2 before it is submitted. Log in with your university credentials to view and confirm your tax information.
https://aamu-employee-portal.com/w2/login
Human Resources

Your account has been reported for copyright infringement. If you believe this is a mistake, you must submit an appeal within 24 hours or your account will be permanently deleted. Submit appeal: https://instagram-appeals-center.com/appeal

Earn $500 weekly just by driving! A beverage company wants to wrap your car with their logo. No cost to you. We will send you a check for $2,450, deposit it and send $1,950 to the wrap specialist via Zelle. Reply with your name and address to get started.

Hello, the French bulldog puppy is still available and fully vaccinated. She is free to a good home, you only pay the $250 delivery fee with a gift card or Zelle. Please send your full name and address so the pet transport company can ship her today.
BofA Alert: Your debit card has been restricted due to suspicious activity. Reply YES to confirm the $689.00 purchase or visit bofa-cardcheck.info to unlock your card.

Hello Bulldog,
You were overcharged for your fall textbook rentals. A refund of $147.25 is waiting for you. Enter your debit card number, expiration date and CVV to receive your refund within 24 hours.
http://aamu-bookstore-refund.com/refund

Hi, I'm Sarah from a recruiting agency. Your profile matched a flexible online role, 30-60 minutes a day, daily pay $300-$800. Are you interested? Please contact me on WhatsApp +44 7700 900123 for details.

Professor Allen has shared a document with you: Midterm_Exam_Answers.docx
Click here to open: https://docs-google-share.com/document/d/open
You need to sign in to view this document.

Hey sweetheart, I'm a busy businessman looking for a kind student to mentor. I'll pay you $1,000 weekly allowance just to chat. To receive your first payment, send me your bank login so I can deposit it directly.

Important: Your registration has been cancelled due to an unpaid balance. To reinstate your classes, log in to Banner Self-Service and confirm your payment information within 24 hours.
https://banner-selfservice-aamu.com/login
Office of the Registrar

Your order #112-4839201 for Apple MacBook Pro ($1,849.00) has been confirmed and will be shipped to Phoenix, AZ. If you did not place this order, please contact Amazon support immediately at 1-888-555-0199 to request a refund.
Complete our 2-minute student survey and receive a $100 Visa gift card! Only 50 rewards left. Start now: https://campus-survey-gifts.live/start?ref=aamu
T-Mobile: Your account has a pending credit of $55.00 due to a billing error. Claim before it expires tonight: http://t-mobile-credit.co/claim

Good evening! We are offering COVID relief and Pell grant cash to students at AAMU. You don't need to pay it back. Just send your student ID number, date of birth and Cash App tag to apply. Limited funds.

A file has been shared with you on OneDrive
INVOICE_09-2026.pdf (2 pages)
To view the file securely, verify your Office 365 email account.
VIEW FILE: https://onedrive-files-share.com/view

This is Officer Daniels with the Madison County Sheriff. A warrant has been issued for your arrest for missing jury duty. To avoid arrest today you must pay a $750 fine using gift cards. Call me back immediately.
yo bro I accidentally reported your Steam account, it's going to be banned. contact the admin on discord and give them your login so they can fix it fast
FINAL NOTICE: Your electricity service will be disconnected today at 4:00 PM due to a past due balance of $212.80. Pay immediately at hsv-utilities-pay.com to avoid disconnection.
Hey! Are you joining the study group for networking tonight? We're meeting at 8 in room 214. I'll bring snacks.

Thanks for your order, Toluwani!
Order #902384711
2 items, total $34.18
We'll let you know when your order is ready for pickup at Huntsville Target. You can view your order in the Target app.

Microsoft account
Security info was added
The following security info was recently added to the Microsoft account to***@aamu.edu: Authenticator app.
If this was you, you can safely ignore this email. If not, review your recent activity at account.microsoft.com.
Team, practice is moved to the indoor facility tomorrow because of the rain. Be there by 3:30 with your gear. Film session after practice.

Jordan Williams paid you $18.00
For: pizza 🍕
The money is now in your Venmo balance. You can transfer it to your bank anytime in the app.
Student Health Center: Reminder of your appointment on Monday, Oct 5 at 10:30 AM. Please arrive 10 minutes early and bring your insurance card. Reply C to confirm.

You're in! Welcome to HackHSV 2026
We're excited to have you at our 36-hour hackathon on October 17-18 at the Huntsville Cyber Center. Check-in opens at 9am. Bring your laptop, charger and student ID. Prizes include internships and $5,000 in awards.
Hi all, quick reminder that Lab 5 is due Friday at midnight on Canvas. If you need an extension, email Dr. Reed directly. Office hours this week are moved to Thursday 1-3pm.

Your receipt from Apple.
iCloud+ with 50 GB storage, monthly $0.99
Billed to Visa •••• 1182
If you have questions about your bill, visit apple.com/support.
Hi Toluwani, it was great meeting you at the career fair. I'd be happy to look over your resume and connect you with our recruiting team. Send it over whenever you're ready.
Rent is due on the 1st, I'll Zelle the landlord my half tomorrow. Can you send yours by Friday? Also we're out of dish soap lol

Network outage update: Wi-Fi service in the residence halls has been restored. If you are still experiencing issues, restart your device or contact the ITS help desk at extension 8888. Thank you for your patience.
Hungry? Get $5 off your next order of $20 or more this weekend. Offer applies automatically at checkout in the Uber Eats app. Terms apply.
Thank you for signing up to volunteer on Saturday, October 10! Please arrive at 7:45am at the build site on Oakwood Ave. Wear closed-toe shoes. Lunch will be provided.

Wells Fargo: Did you attempt a purchase of $42.10 at Kroger with your card ending in 3391? If yes, no action needed. If not, call the number on the back of your card. We will never ask for your PIN or password.
I finished the model training part and the results look good, recall is around 98%. Let's meet tomorrow to put together the demo and practice the presentation.
Duo: 482913 is your passcode for AAMU login. Do not share this code. AAMU will never ask you for it.
Good morning! Just checking in on you. Praying your exams go well this week. Sunday service is at 10 and we have lunch after for the students.
